function.name: GRAPHIC_INFO
function.param: Number of graph inside of the library

Type of attribute to consult. It can be: Width in pixels of the graph Height in pixels of the graph Horizontal coordinate of the center Vertical coordinate of the center Different in bytes, in memory, between two rows of the graph Depth of colour (in bits per pixel) Total de "versiones" del gráfico Current frame of the animation Number of frames of the animation Current speed of the animation
function.abstract: It allows to consult an attribute of a graph

description.p: This function allows to access in runtime to determined attributes of a graph, specially of his animation, although it results useful to access to the content of the graph by too.
The animations of the MAP graphs are automatic, and independent of the frames per second established by the function .
